primitives.name: Duplicate Gate Extension
primitives.verbatim_quote: # BUILD-NRT-037: Public player card remediation map ## Duplicate Gate duplicate_check_status: EXTENSION matched_existing_ids: BUILD-GV2-053 relation_to_existing: Extends existing source freshness/player surface/data quality work with roster-specific truth rules.
primitives.assumptions: The existence of a prior truth layer (BUILD-GV2-053) defines base freshness rules; this extension applies roster-specific overrides.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When a new card matches an existing ID, it must extend rather than replace the prior truth layer.

layer2.mapping: Duplicate gate maps to a set inclusion check in a truth lattice where each node represents a canonical roster fact.
layer2.telemetry: Verification that matched IDs are extended, not overwritten.

primitives.name: Roster Fact Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Validation Plan Run roster:audit, roster:verify, roster:conflicts, roster:stale, and test:roster once implemented.
primitives.assumptions: Each roster fact is validated against a set of source evidences using predefined rules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Validation fails when a fact is stale, contradicted, or lacks sufficient evidence.

layer2.mapping: Validation kernel computes a posterior belief over fact truth given evidence likelihood and temporal consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Audit logs of validation passes/failures per fact.

primitives.name: Official Evidence Precedence
primitives.verbatim_quote: Official current evidence wins unless stale or contradicted by newer official transaction evidence.
primitives.assumptions: Temporal and authoritative provenance of evidence determines truth value in case of conflict.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Conflicting facts are resolved by timestamp and source authority hierarchy.

layer2.mapping: Precedence rule is modeled as a partial order on evidence timestamps within a truth lattice.
layer2.telemetry: Timestamp and authority level of winning evidence per fact.
